name: Local React Test
description: Real-time deployment activity dashboard for Salesforce orgs

initialMessages.content: I want to build a real-time deployment activity dashboard for my Salesforce org. It should show recent deployments with status (Queued/In Progress/Succeeded/Failed), component counts, start time, and duration. I need filtering by status and date range, auto-refresh while deployments are running, and a detail view that lists every component in a deployment with its individual result.
I'll build that for you. The project has a React frontend ready to go. I'll start with the deployment list view and status polling, then add filtering and the component detail drilldown. Here goes!

seedMessages.content: How should I describe a failed deployment in the activity feed?

Lead with the outcome and the cause, never just a red badge. Say what failed, which component, and the single next action — e.g. "Deploy failed: ApexClass OrderTrigger — line 42 references a field that no longer exists. Re-pull metadata and redeploy." Concise, blameless, actionable.
